description: This file defines the EachBlock class in the SCSSPHP project, representing a block for iteration in the SCSS PHP compiler. It extends the base Block class and manages variables and list data for loop constructs.

classes.name: ScssPhp\ScssPhp\Block\EachBlock
classes.description: Represents a 'each' loop block in SCSS, maintaining variables and list to iterate over.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EachBlock instance and sets its type to T_EACH.
